description: Recent change-events, newest first: a rate moved, a product was added, or a product was withdrawn. Each event has the lender, the product's name and category, and field-level deltas (e.g. rate [6.09, 5.89], bps -20). Filter by institutionId, category, kind and direction. Returns `limit` events (default 50, at most 200); `truncated` says more match. This is a diff of RateSonar's consecutive captured observations.

direction.description: Optional: only rate rises (up) or cuts (down).

institutionId.description: Optional, e.g. "cba". Omit for all lenders.

name: rate_changes
